mentions.name: Octocat juggler
mentions.description: A GitHub badge that displays in how many repositories a user is currently working, linking to the user's stats by default.
mentions.source_excerpt: Today I built Octocat juggler. It's a GitHub badge that shows in how many repos are you working. By default it links to some stats.
